title: Lanterns Returns to 2026, But Episode 6 Leaves Fans in Doubt
seoTitle: Lanterns Returns to 2026, But Episode 6 Leaves Fans in.
subtitle: The series tries to balance past and future, but Hal Jordan's death raises questions
excerpt: Lanterns returns to the future in episode 6, but Hal Jordan's death makes the series lose the dynamic that made it popular.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Lanterns returns to the future in 2026 in the sixth episode, but Hal Jordan's death completely changes the series' dynamic. The plot, which had already spent half its time in 2016, now focuses on John Stewart trying to solve Hal's murder and deal with his own past.

what changed in 2026

Episode 6 shows John Stewart in Rushville, facing family issues and suspicion of having been involved in Hal's murder. The script tries to show how the character lives in a post-superhero world, but Hal's absence reduces the tension the series had in previous seasons.

the impact of hal jordan's death

Hal Jordan no longer appears in the plot, which causes the series to lose the dynamic between the two Green Lanterns. The only scene where they meet takes place in a diner, just hours before Hal is mysteriously killed. This scene, although well-crafted, is not enough to compensate for Hal's absence.

guy gardner's role

Guy Gardner appears on the scene, helping to fill the void left by Hal. His presence brings a new chemistry with John and opens up possibilities for the series to explore Guy's story in future seasons. The cameo also explains why Guy is the Green Lantern in 2025, as revealed in "Superman".

the narrative challenges

The episode tries to balance the murder investigation, John's life, and the 2026 plot, but some subplots, like a waitress's blackmail, feel forced. The series needs to refocus on the central mystery and the questions surrounding Hal's death to maintain viewer interest.

what to expect in the next episodes

With the return of the Halogram, the series can resume the chemistry between Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler. The next episode is expected to dive deeper into the investigation and show how John faces his future as a Green Lantern, while the series tries to balance the DC franchise's past and present.

With information from IGN, Nerdist, TheWrap.
